scenes.text: Imagine sitting in a room so incredibly quiet that the silence itself becomes deafening, a place where all external noise is blocked and sound reflections are completely absorbed.
Within minutes of being inside this Microsoft anechoic chamber, your ears adapt to the absolute silence, and you begin to hear things you never should, like your own heartbeat pounding like a drum.
Soon, you can actually hear the blood rushing through your veins, your lungs expanding, and even your moving joints making a loud, scraping noise.

Most people cannot stand to be in here for more than forty-five minutes before they begin to hallucinate and lose their balance, so would you dare to try it, or would you panic and run? Subscribe for more.
